name: library-os
description: Library OS — the open-source Library Intelligence System. Capture, extract, enrich, and publish every book you read into a permanent deep-dive on your own website. Composes the Starlight Intelligence Protocol (SIP) substrate.
principles: Every book read → a permanent deep-dive page on your own domain
Highlights are raw input; structured deep-dives are the output
Reading is a writing practice — extract + enrich, never just collect
Local-first: your library lives in your repo, not a SaaS
SIP-attested: every published deep-dive carries Built on SIP
attestation: Built on SIP — Starlight Intelligence Protocol v1.1.1. License: MIT.
